entities.summary: Robert Errey is a Canadian former professional ice hockey left wing and former sportscaster for the Pittsburgh Penguins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 15th overall by Pittsburgh in the 1983 NHL entry draft and played 895 NHL games over the course of his career.
